name: Food Conversations: Lunch Lingo
source:
A cozy visual novel that puts you in charge of a brand-new Japanese restaurant in a bustling city. Over the course of several days, you’ll craft unique dishes, unlock new ingredients and recipes, and build relationships with a colourful cast of customers - from the overstretched office mom Susumu to trend-setting high schooler Haru and drama-queen mangaka Ryoichi.

Customize your character’s name (and even your restaurant’s!), dive into narrative scenes, then pause the story to select three ingredients, cook, and serve - up to five dishes per day. As you succeed, decorate and personalize your eatery, and watch both your menu and your customer base grow.

[From [url=https://otojang.itch.io/food-conversations-lunch-lingo]itch.io[/url]]
